lutsen-mountains.quote: ANTICIPATED OPENING DAY OF THE 2026/2027 SEASON IS NOVEMBER 28th
lutsen-mountains.note: Lutsen Mountains website lift status banner, seen 18 November 2026: "ANTICIPATED OPENING DAY OF THE 2026/2027 SEASON IS NOVEMBER 28th". Lutsen also emailed David the 28th. Replaces the 26 November seen on 5 November; the homepage copy still read 26th on the 18th. Instagram, seen 20 November 2026, supplied by David: "We're shifting our anticipated Opening Day to Saturday, November 28th."

chester-bowl.note: Chester Bowl season pass page, seen 5 November 2026: "Opening Day: Sunday, December 12, 2026" under Important Dates, and "Tentative Opening Day (weather permitting): December 12".

giants-ridge.quote: Our planned opening day is now set for December 4th
giants-ridge.note: Instagram, seen 20 November 2026, supplied by David: the extended forecast lacks enough sustained snowmaking to open with quality conditions; "Our planned opening day is now set for December 4th". Replaces the 27 November planned date seen 5 November.

spirit-mountain.quote: Our tentative opening day, weather permitting, is 11/27/26.
spirit-mountain.note: Spirit Mountain homepage Mountain Message dated 16 November 2026, seen 18 November 2026: "Winter prep is in full swing here at Spirit! Our tentative opening day, weather permitting, is 11/27/26. Stay tuned!" Instagram, seen 20 November 2026, supplied by David: "We're still aiming for our tentative opening day of Friday, November 27th."

powder-ridge.quote: FRIDAY 11/27 | 10 AM – 5 PM Season Pass Holders Only Day
powder-ridge.note: Instagram, seen 20 November 2026, supplied by David: kicking off the 2026/2027 season Friday 27 November, 10am-5pm, season pass holders only; open to everyone Saturday 28 November; Sunday 29 November 10am-5pm.
